name: 浏览器自动化
description: 给 agent 的浏览器工具:打开网页、读页面结构、点击、填表、滚动、截图、按目标自动导航;面板地址栏带收藏和历史;网页里划词弹出复合框(引用标签 + 问题输入框,翻译/解释/收藏,回车把问题连同引用发送到对话),翻译与解释由 agent 完成后回显在框内。面板内嵌宿主浏览器引擎视图(地址栏归插件,引擎与登录态归宿主)。

tools.name: browser_show
tools.description: Show a result to the user inside the browser — the card in the web page (or the panel). This is the ONLY way to deliver something the user asked to see there: when they select page text and pick 翻译 / 解释, the popup waits for this call, so answer with it instead of replying in the conversation. Also use it for any other content you were asked to display in the browser (a summary of the page, a rewritten paragraph).

text.description: The content to display — the full translation or explanation, not a summary of it.

title.description: Short heading for the card, e.g. "译文" or "要点". Optional.

kind.description: What this is: "translate" or "explain" when answering a selection-popup request, so the card is labelled correctly.

tools.name: browser_clips_list
tools.description: List the pieces of page text the user kept with the selection popup's 收藏 button. Use it when they ask what they saved while reading, or refer to "我收藏的那段话".

query.description: Words to match against the saved text and the page it came from. Empty returns the most recent clips.

tools.name: browser_history_search
tools.description: Search the pages this browser has visited. Use it when the user refers to a site they (or you) opened before — "再打开上次那个网站" — instead of asking them to retype the address. Returns each match's title, URL, when it was last visited, and how often.

query.description: Words to match against page titles and URLs, e.g. "招聘" or "github react" — every word must appear. Empty returns the most recent visits.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: browser_favorites_list
tools.description: List the sites the user starred in the browser panel. Use it to resolve "打开我常用的那个网站" into a real URL, or to see which sites the user cares about before navigating.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the built-in browser to a URL and wait for it to load. Returns the final URL and page title.

url.description: The URL to open, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: browser_tab_list
tools.description: List this conversation's browser tabs: id, title/url, and which is focused. Multi-tab workflows start here.

tools.name: browser_tab_open
tools.description: Open a NEW browser tab (optionally at a URL) in this conversation and focus it. The page tools then act on the focused tab, or on `tab` when given. Page state (login, scroll, forms) is kept per tab.

url.description: URL to load; omit for a blank tab.

tools.name: browser_tab_switch
tools.description: Focus one of this conversation's tabs by id (from browser_tab_list). Subsequent page tools act on it.

tools.name: browser_tab_close
tools.description: Close one of this conversation's tabs by id.

tools.name: browser_get_state
tools.description: Get the current URL, page title, and a snapshot of the page's interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs — each with a ref you can pass to browser_click / browser_fill). Call this FIRST after navigating to see what is on the page. Do NOT call it again just to confirm an action: every action (and browser_act) already returns a fresh snapshot. Use browser_screenshot only for visual layout.

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Find interactive elements on the current page by text query (fuzzy match, scored). Returns matches with role, visible text, page section, and a ref usable as a click/fill selector. Use it when browser_get_state's snapshot was truncated or you need to locate one specific control.

query.description: Text to search for, e.g. "登录" or "search"

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element in the built-in browser. Waits up to 5s for the element, scrolls it into view, then clicks. The result reports what changed on the page (new text or a URL change), so you do NOT need to re-check with browser_get_state or browser_evaluate. On failure the result suggests similar elements. If the click opens a confirm(), the dialog is DISMISSED by default and the result says what was asked; pass dialog:"accept" ONLY when the user explicitly asked you to confirm — never on your own judgment.

selector.description: Element selector. Preferred: a ref from browser_get_state/browser_find, e.g. "[12]". Also accepted: text="登录", role=button[name="提交"], or a CSS selector.

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

dialog.description: How to answer a confirm()/alert() that this click triggers. Default dismiss. Pass accept ONLY when the user explicitly asked to confirm this action.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.description: Run several browser steps in one call: click / fill / select / upload / hover / wait. Steps run in order and stop at the first failure; the result lists what each step did plus the page's CURRENT interactive snapshot — that snapshot is authoritative, so do NOT follow up with browser_get_state or browser_evaluate to confirm. Use it for sequences you can already see on the page (fill every field, then submit). Do NOT batch a step whose target only appears after an earlier one — click that first, look, then batch the rest. A click that raises a confirm() is dismissed unless the step sets dialog:"accept".

steps.description: Ordered steps; each step uses exactly one key.

click.description: Selector to click — a ref like "[3]" is preferred

dialog.description: Answer a confirm()/alert() raised by this step. Default dismiss; accept only when the user explicitly asked to confirm.

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_upload
tools.description: Attach local files to a page's upload control — file pickers, '添加附件', '上传' buttons, and drag-and-drop-only zones (pages with no file input at all: the host synthesises a real drop). Clicking the control lets the browser report which input the page wants, so hidden, dynamically created and iframe-hosted (same-origin or cross-origin) inputs all work. Pass absolute paths. NEVER call browser_fill on a file input, and do NOT read file bytes yourself — this tool already does. The result reports what appeared on the page, so do NOT verify with browser_evaluate.

selector.description: The control that opens the file picker — a ref like "[12]" is preferred — or the file input itself.

files.description: Absolute paths of the files to attach.

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Fill an input field (replaces existing content; works with React/Vue controlled inputs). Focuses the field first and reads it back afterwards: the result reports the field's current value, so do NOT verify it yourself with browser_evaluate.

selector.description: Input selector — same formats as browser_click (ref like "[3]" is preferred).

value.description: The text to type into the field

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover the pointer over an element — for menus and tooltips that only appear on hover.

selector.description: Element selector — same formats as browser_click.

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Select an option in a <select> dropdown by value or visible text. The result reports which option ended up selected — no need to read it back.

selector.description: Select-element selector — same formats as browser_click.

value.description: Option value or visible text to select

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page up or down.

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page context and return its JSON value. Power tool for reading computed data (e.g. document.title, table contents) that the snapshot misses. The page can tell it runs — never use it to bypass a site's defenses.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate, e.g. JSON.stringify({h1: document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent})

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.

tools.name: browser_walk
tools.description: Goal-directed navigation: state the target (e.g. "进入个人设置页") and the browser plans and executes the click path itself, using screenshot analysis. Use it when a site needs several dependent clicks to reach a place and you do not know its structure. Requires a vision model to be configured; falls back to keyword matching when planning fails. Verify the result with browser_get_state afterwards.

goal.description: The destination in plain language, e.g. "打开文章编辑器"

maxSteps.description: Maximum click steps to try. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page in the built-in browser. Returns a base64 PNG image you can see directly. Use it for visual layout, design, charts, or CAPTCHA-style content the element snapshot cannot express — NOT to confirm form values, text, or whether a click worked; the snapshot returned by the action already answers those.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of the viewport

tab.description: Act on this tab id (from browser_tab_list) instead of the conversation's focused tab.
